### Description

As part of #4178, tests using the deprecated `test::Relay` mock system are being refactored to use `Server::EcmScope()`.

In `test/integration/kinematic_links.cc`, the `KinematicCmd` test already uses `server.EcmScope()`, but the helper function `RunWorld()` still uses `test::Relay recorder;` with `OnPostUpdate()` to capture final state.

`State::Record()` clears contact history and overwrites link heights on every step, meaning only the post-run state is inspected. Replacing `test::Relay` with `server.EcmScope()` after running iterations eliminates `Relay.hh` from this test completely and improves execution efficiency.

### Tasks
- [ ] Refactor `RunWorld()` in `test/integration/kinematic_links.cc` to use `server.EcmScope()`.
- [ ] Remove `#include "../helpers/Relay.hh"`.
new_candidates.title: Refactor kinematic_links integration test to use EcmScope

new_candidates.body:
I've published an EnvHub Space with LeRobot's first aerial robot: https://huggingface.co/spaces/vishwagw/crazyflie-envhub (commit 71060e3e98bb85be2667632311f243834ad93bd0). It is a Crazyflie 2.x simulated with gym-pybullet-drones (MIT), with hover and waypoint tasks, fpv and chase cameras, and position and velocity as state. Its actions are delta_x, delta_y, delta_z velocity commands (control_mode: delta), so the gamepad and keyboard_ee teleoperators fly it as a sim robot without changes.

Tested on current main with the checks in envhub.mdx: make_env, the SimRobot check, lerobot-env-server from the folder, and a lerobot-eval run with an ACT checkpoint. A scripted expert that reads the true target succeeds 20/20 on both tasks. Rendering is CPU-only (PyBullet's TinyRenderer), with no GPU needed. I'd like it added to the EnvHub environments collection.
new_candidates.title: EnvHub listing request: Crazyflie quadrotor (gym-pybullet-drones)
